slides.headline: 6 AI PROMPTS THAT REPLACE YOUR $10,000 PITCH DECK FOR FREE
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei, triumphant grin, both hands thrusting pitch deck with FREE symbol toward camera, clean bright background, documentary style, natural skin texture, warm amber accent.

slides.headline: 1) WRITE THE PROBLEM SLIDE IN UNDER A MINUTE
slides.body: A pitch deck consultant charges $5,000 to $15,000. Ask Claude for: one sharp sentence naming the core pain, three bullets proving the problem is widespread, and the cost if nothing changes.

slides.headline: 2) CALCULATE MARKET SIZE THE WAY INVESTORS WANT
slides.body: Founders who write "we're targeting a $500 billion market" lose the room. Ask Claude for a bottom-up calculation: potential customers multiplied by average annual spend. Show TAM, SAM, SOM.
slides.image_prompt: A hand presses a black marker to a whiteboard drawing three bold concentric circles — each tagged with a large $ symbol, a multiplication arrow beneath them connecting to an upward chart below; a glass-walled boardroom floods daylight behind. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: deep green against chalk white.

slides.headline: 3) BUILD THE WHY NOW SLIDE MOST FOUNDERS SKIP
slides.body: Most founders skip this slide and get told to "come back with more traction." Ask Claude for three forces: one technology shift, one behavior change, one regulatory shift. Why now, not three years ago.

slides.headline: 4) TURN YOUR NUMBERS INTO A TRACTION SLIDE
slides.body: Most traction slides list milestones. Investors fund momentum. Ask Claude to pick the three strongest signals, calculate month-over-month growth, and lead with that number, bullet points an investor scans in 5 seconds.

slides.headline: 5) SELL YOUR TEAM WITHOUT BRAGGING
slides.body: A list of job titles tells investors nothing. One sentence connecting each founder's past to why they win this market tells investors everything. Ask Claude: no titles, earned credibility and unfair advantages only.

slides.headline: 6) WRITE THE ASK SLIDE SO INVESTORS SAY YES
slides.body: Investors who like the deck but don't understand the ask do not write checks. Ask Claude for round size, three uses of funds with dollar amounts, and the milestone this round reaches.

slides.body:
